content: Yeyox te kõmẽn Yenoyanẽn tu' xupep
Ha ta' mõg, tu mõktu kõmẽn Yenoyanẽn yĩka' pip, 'ĩhã' pip'ax Metpaye tu' mõxaha', ha yĩktix 'Onimet yĩka' yũm, tu' yõg tik 2 mõ'kutnãhã', pu' keppa mõg,
tu' xat, hu: —Mõg, nõm xip tu xexka ha mõg, tu mõktu mõxaha', ha yohmẽn hex pẽnãp-tup, hak-tok te nũ mũtik tihi', ha' mĩm tu' hĩy, ha mõy hĩy'ax koa', nũy nũnnã'.
Tikmũ'ũn te xa' yĩkopit, 'ãpu yĩy, tu: “'Ũgmũg xuxyã te yohmẽn putup, tu' putpu' nũnnãp-tup,” kaxĩy, ha 'ãtux hok putup xa yohmẽn 2 nũnnã'. Kaxĩy.
Ha hãpxopmãhã', tu Topa yõg hãm'ãktux hittap hã yohmẽn nũnnãhã'. Hõmã tik hittap te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux, tu tappet tu kax'ãmi',
hu:

content.text: “Pu, Xiãm yõg kõmẽn kopa' pip xop pu hãm'ãktux, hu:
Hõnhã tik te tikmũ'ũn xat'ax xupep,
tu yãk-tõgnãg, tu yohmẽn yĩmũ' yũm,
tu yohmẽn kutok yĩmũ' yũm.” Kaxĩy.

content: Ha ta tik xop mõg, tu Yeyox keppa' mõg, tu' xat'ax mĩy,
tu yohmẽn nũnnãhã', xik-tok nũnnãhã', tu yãy kap xix yohmẽn yĩmũ', pu Yeyox yĩmũ' yũm, ha' yũm,
ha tikmũ'ũn xohix yãy yõg kap mõ'yõn hãm tu', pu yohmẽn mõy yĩmũ' mõg,

ha mõktu tikmũ'ũn te' keppa' mõg, xix tikmũ'ũn te' pe' mõg, yĩy ka'ok, tu: —Mõnãyxop hittap Namix mõkputox xexka xe'ẽgnãg! Pũyã Topa xa hãmmaxnã'! Yã xa' hõm yãy 'ãxet'ax, xa nũ'! Yã Topa mũn xexka xe'ẽgnãg! Kaxĩy.
Tu kõmẽn Yenoyanẽn tu' mõxaha', 'ĩhã tikmũ'ũn xohix te' xupak, tu: —Putep mũn mĩy? 'Ũ 'ũm 'õhõm? Kaxĩy.
Ha tikmũ'ũn te Yeyox mũtik mõxaha, tu: —Yã nõ'õm Yeyox, tu Topa pupi hãm'ãktux, yã hãpxexka yõg kõmẽn Nãyane yõg tihik. Kaxĩy.
Yeyox te Topa pet xexka hã mõ'nãhã'

Yeyox te Topa pet xexka hã mõ'nãhã', tu tikmũ'ũn papuk, nõm te' kopa hãpxop hãmenax, tu tayũmak yãnãn'ax xop yõg mĩmpe putxok, xix yãy yũm'ax putxok kamah, tu tik xop te putuxnãg hãmenax yõg yũm'ax putxok.
Ha Yeyox te: —Topa yõg tappet te Topa yõg hãm'ãktux'ax 'ãktux, ha: “'Ũkpet xexka 'ãxet'ax Topa pu hãm'ãktux'ax pet,” kaxĩy, pa 'ãxop te Topa pet xexka kummugãhã', ha yãyhã hãpxupxet pet! Kaxĩy.
Ha tikmũ'ũn pa hok xop nũn, xix tikmũ'ũn te hãpkumep hok xop nũn, Topa pet xexka ha' nũn, puyĩy Yeyox hittupmã', ha' hittupmãhã',

yĩy 'ãmãnex xexka xop gãy, xix tik te hãmyũmmũg xop gãy, 'ĩhã Yeyox te hãpxopmã max xe'ẽgnãg, ha' pẽnãhã', ha kakxop yĩy ka'ok Topa pet xexka kopah, tu: —Mõnãyxop hittap Namix mõkputox xexka xe'ẽgnãg! Kaxĩy. Ha' xexka xop te' xupak.

Tu Yeyox pu hãm'ãktux, hu: —'Ok xate kakxop yĩy 'ũm 'ãpak? Kaxĩy. Ha: —Yã 'ãte' xupak. 'Ok 'ãxop te Topa yõg tappet 'ũm mõ'kupix hok? Yã: “Topa te kakxop pu hãmyũmmũgãhã', pu tu Topa 'ãktux mãynãg.” Kaxĩy.
Tu ta' nĩm, tu kõmẽn nĩm kamah, tu' pip'ax Metãn ha' mõg, tu mõktu' pip'ax tu' xip 'ãmnĩy tox hã.
Yeyox te piget kup mãnõg
Hãptup 'ĩhã' mõg, Yenoyanẽn tu putpu' mõg, ha putup te Yeyox putex,
ha ta mĩnta kup piget pẽnãhã', ha putat puka' yũm, yĩ' mõg, pa mĩnta 'ũm ta 'ohnãg, 'ũxux puxet mõ'tat, yĩy Yeyox te' kup xat, hu: —Mĩnta 'ũm ta hok! Kaxĩy. Hãpxip 'ohnãg 'ĩhã mĩnta kup yã tãmnãg,
ha tik xop te' pẽnãhã', tu' kuxa te' yẽy, tu: —Yã' kup tãmnãg mõ'ka'ok! Kaxĩy.

Ha Yeyox te: —'Ãte xa hãpxe'e 'ãktux: 'Ãkuxa mãm ka'ok xix yãy kuxa yĩkopit hok, hu ta mĩnta kup nakgã kamah, tu' xat'ax hã' nakgãhã', pãyãp-xet'ah. 'Ãxop te yĩktix xat'ax, pu 'ãpep, nũy kõnãg xexka kopa mõ'yãykutnã', puxix mõ'kutnã'.
'Ãkuxa mãm ka'ok, puxix Topa xa' hõm hãpxop 'ũm 'ãxop te ta tu 'ãkax. Kaxĩy.
Yeyox te' xat'ax

Tu Topa pet xexka ha' mõg putpu', tu hãmyũmmũgãhã', 'ĩhã 'ãmãnex xexka xop nũn, xix Yoneo xexka xop nũn, tu Yeyox yĩka' pip, tu' yĩkopit, hu: —Tep te xa' hõm yãy 'ãxet'ax, xayĩy hãpxopmã ka'ok xix hãmyũmmũgã'? Kaxĩy.
Ha: —'Ãte 'ãyĩkopit'ax kamah, xa 'ãxop hãm'ãktux 'ũyãnãn tu', kopxix xa hãm'ãktux, tup-tep te 'ã' hõm yãy 'ãxet'ax, ha xa' xuktux.

'Ãyĩy! Tep te Yoãm pu 'ãxet'ax hõm, pu tup-tox pix? 'Ok pe Topa te tu' hõm? 'Ok pe tikmũ'ũn te tu' hõm? Kaxĩy. Ha' xexka xop te yãy pu hãm'ãktux hã' nõy yãnãn, hu: —Pax 'ũ yũmũ'ãte: Topa te tu 'ãxet'ax hõm,” kaxĩy, puxi' yãnãn tu' yĩkopit, hu: “Teptu 'ãkuxa mãm 'ohnãg Yoãm kopah?” kaxĩy.
Pax 'ũ yũmũ'ãte: “Tikmũ'ũn te' xuxet'ax tu' hõm,” kaxĩy, puxix tikmũ'ũn gãy, ha yũmũ'ãte' yĩpkutuk. Yã' xohix te Yoãm pe'paxex 'ũxexkah, tu pe'paxex Yoãm te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux. Kaxĩy.
Hu' yãnãn tu hãm'ãktux, hu: —'Ap yũmmũg'ah 'ãte'. Kaxĩy. Ha Yeyox te: —'A 'ãte xa hãm'ãktux putup'ah kamah, tu yãy 'ũm 'ãxet'ax 'ã' hõm 'ãktux putup'ah. Kaxĩy.
Tik kutok 2

Tu xe hãmyũmmũgãhã hãm'ãktux'ax hã, nũy Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgã', tu: —Xatep tep pe'ãpaxex? Tik kutok pit 2, tuk-tok hãmãxap xat, nũy: “Xõnnũ', mõy nõmhã nũy yõgnũ mĩnta 'op yõg hãpxa'ax tu 'ãhãm.” Kaxĩy.
—Hak-tok te mãxap te: “'Ap 'ũgmõg putup'ah.” Kaxĩy. —Pa hãpxip kutõgnãg 'ĩhã yãyhãhup, tu' mõg.
—Ha' tak tek-tok kuhnõy xat kamah, pu mõy tu hãm, hak-tok te kuhmõy te: “Yãk mõg.” Kaxĩy. —Pa' mõg 'õhnãg. Kaxĩy.

Tu hãm'ãktux kux, tu' xexka xop yĩkopit, hu: —'Ũk-tok te xĩy te' tak pu' yĩpkox xip? Kaxĩy. Ha: —Yãk-tok te mãxap. Kaxĩy. Yĩy Yeyox te: —Gohet pupi tayũmak pop xop xi' xotit xop te Topa pu' yĩpkox pip, pãyã 'ãyĩpkox 'ohnãg.

Yã Yoãm tep-tox pix, tu 'ãkeppa' mõg nũy xa Topa yõg putat mũg, ha 'ãkuxa mãm 'õhnãg Yoãm kopah, pãyã tayũmak pop xop xi' xotit xop kuxa mãm ka'ok. Ha 'ãxop te' yũmmũg, tu yãyhãhũp 'ohnãg, nũy hãpkummuk mĩy kux, nũy 'ãkuxa mãm ka'ok Yoãm kopah. Kaxĩy.
Tute kãmãnat kummuk 'ãktux

Tu xe: —'Ũg 'ãpax! Hãm'ãktux'ax nõy hã 'ãte xa hãmyũmmũgã'ax, nũy Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax xa hãmyũmmũgã', hu: Tikmũ'ũn te hãpxaha', tu mĩnta 'op xok, tu hãmpak'ax hã' yĩmmap, tu mĩkaxxap xox tix hã' tat'ax mĩy, pu tox hep 'op tonnok, nũy' hep xut, nũy ta hep xupyãg mĩy, xix mĩptut tox mĩy, nũy hãpxa xexka pẽnã', ha tikmũ'ũn nõy pu' nĩm, tayũmak hã' nõy yãnãn tu', tu ta hãpkumep hãptox tu'.
Ha ta hãmyãxatamuk 'ĩhã' xuxyã te kãmãnat tikoxyuk nũ'pok, pu tu' xuxyã yõg tayũmak nõm pupi pa'.
Pa hãpxa xexka yõg kãmãnat te' mũg, tup-xet kix, xi' nõy putex, xi' nõy mĩkaxxap hã' tux.
Hãpxip 'ĩhã' xuxyã te xe kãmãnat xop nũ'pok, tu ta kãmãnat punethok nũ'pok, pu tu' xuxyã pupi tayũmak pop, ha hãpxa xexka yõg kãmãnat xop te xe hãpxopmã kummuk.
Yĩy hãpxip 'ĩhã' xuxyã te nũ yãy kutok kutnãhã', tu hãmpe'paxex, hu: “Yãk kutok xexka pe'paxex'ax, 'ap kummugãp-tup'ah.” Kaxĩy.
Ha ta' nũn, pa hãpxa xexka yõg kãmãnat te' pẽnãhã', tu: “Yã' xuxyãk-tok xe'e'! 'Ãpu yũmũp-tex, nũy hãpxa xexka pa'!” Kaxĩy.
—Tuk-tok mũg, tu hãpxa xexka kũnãpa ha' mõgãhã', tu' mõg, tup-tex, ha' xok. 'Ũkux. Kaxĩy.
Yeyox te' yĩkopit, hu: —Tep mũn mĩy'ax 'ũxuxyã', 'ĩhã' putpu' nũn, nũy hãpxa xexka yõg kãmãnat xop 'ũyãnãn tu' kummugã'? Kaxĩy.
Ha tikmũ'ũn te: —Ya' kix'ax, nũy hãpxa xexka hõm tikmũ'ũn nõy pu', pu tu' xuxyã pu hãpxa yõg tayũmak hã pago hãmyãxatamuk xohix 'ĩhã'. Kaxĩy.

Yĩy Yeyox te xe' yĩkopit, hu: —'Ok 'ãxop te Topa yõg tappet 'ũm mõ'kupix hok? Ha: “Tikmũ'ũn pet, tu mĩm xexka putup nõg, pa hõnhã yãyhã mĩptut mãykup xix mĩptut koxuk, yã mĩm xexka xe'ẽgnãg. Topa mũn te' xexkãnãhã', ha yũmũg kuxa te' yẽy.” Kaxĩy.
Tu hãm'ãktux kux, tu: —'Ãte xa hãpxe'e 'ãktux: 'A Topa te 'ãxop 'ũm xat putup'ah, pãyã' nõy xat putup, nõm te Topa pu' yĩpkox pip, tu hãpxopmã max.
Tikmũ'ũn te mĩkaxxap hã' nã', puxix tu yãy koxyõy. Mĩkaxxap te tikmũ'ũn yĩmũ' nã', puxix yã' xohix koxyõynãm. Kaxĩy.
Ha 'ãmãnex xexka xop xix Paniye xop te Yeyox yõg hãm'ãktux'ax 'ãpak, tu hãmyũmmũg. Yã' xexka xop 'ãktux 'ĩhã hãm'ãktux hã hãmyũmmũgãhã',
yĩ' gãy, tu' mũg putup, pa tikmũ'ũn yĩpkutuk, ha Yeyox yã' xexka pe'paxex, tu: “Yeyox te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux xe'e'.” Kaxĩy.
